name: create_tool
description: Create a new tool (skill) for an identity. This writes a meta.json declaration and a Python script implementing the tool function. The tool becomes immediately available to the identity on next harness load.

identity_name.description: The identity to add the tool to (e.g. 'dante', 'coder', 'research_expert')

description.description: What the tool does — shown to the LLM in the tool list

parameters_schema.description: JSON Schema for tool parameters (same format as OpenAI function calling). Must include 'type': 'object', 'properties': {...}, 'required': [...]

function_code.description: Complete Python function code. Must define a function with the same name as tool_name. Example: 'def summarize_text(text: str, max_length: int = 100):\n    return text[:max_length]'
